system.description:
Resleeving is not an easy process. You are stuck with the mental image of your original body and have trouble adapting to your new morphs’ looks and physiologies. You have difficulty identifying yourself in mirrors, photos, or sensor feeds. 

You also tend to move in ways inappropriate to your new forms, such as attempting to walk instead of using new limbs or propulsion systems, forgetting to duck when walking through doorways, becoming alarmed by new sensory inputs, etc. You should roleplay this trait accordingly, and may suffer a –10 modifier to applicable actions.
